notes.title: Quantum Barrels, Teleportation, Time Travel
notes.content:
[p]Greetings Legends,[/p][p] [/p][p]In LEGEND BATTLES, the Future of Survival Awaits. The battlefield is alive, shrinking, shifting, and demanding every ounce of strategy.[/p][previewyoutube="aI9xzglx4OM;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][list][*][p]Master the Playzone – Outsmart the ever-closing circle before it consumes you.[/p][/*][*][p]Harness the Five Elements – Collect Quantum Barrels to fuel teleportation and unlock legendary rewards.[/p][/*][*][p]Teleport Across Worlds – Travel instantly between Bellona and Aurora, but beware: the hubs are deadly ambush grounds.[/p][/*][*][p]Defy Death – Recover fallen allies through Respawn Machines, summon the legendary Yellow Hover Taxi, and parachute your squadmates back into the fight.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]Every match is more than a battle—it’s a story of survival, loyalty, and second chances.[/p][p][b]Fall. Be carried. Descend. Fight again.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/b70ed3842e6a58f63c52b2f919b1c7034a19ab1a.png"][/img][/p][p]The world of LEGEND BATTLES is more than just a battlefield—it’s a living arena where technology, mysticism, and survival collide. Every match is a test not only of your combat skills, but of your ability to master the powers of quantum barrels, manipulate teleportation hubs, and even bend time itself through the mysterious respawn machines.[/p][p] [/p][p]And when fate calls you back from beyond, nothing feels more legendary than parachuting from a driverless yellow hover taxi, returning to fight alongside your squad. Prepare yourselves, for the future of battle is here.[/p][p] [/p][p][u][b]1. Shrinking Playzone – Outsmart the Battlefield[/b][/u][/p][p] [/p][p]Survival in LEGEND BATTLES is more than just shooting straight—it’s about mastering the Playzone, the invisible hand that pushes every warrior closer together.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Purpose: Why the Playzone Shrinks[/b]
The ever-tightening battlefield ensures that no match dissolves into endless hiding. Each contraction raises the stakes, forcing players into decisive encounters and keeping the action unrelenting.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Visuals: Reading the Circles[/b]
On your minimap, the Playzone appears as two glowing rings:[/p][list][*][p][b]White Circle[/b] → the next safe zone.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Blue Circle[/b] → the current boundary closing in.[/p][/*][/list][p]Ignore them at your peril.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/32342bbbbb02592eec3f6d83912d8cde2d155e3a.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Damage: The Price of Falling Behind[/b]
Step outside the blue, and reality itself will punish you. Damage begins light in the early phases but intensifies until hesitation means instant death. Only the prepared—with healing and boosting items—can survive its bite.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Shrinking Rate: Always Shifting[/b]
No two matches shrink the same way. Some zones give you breathing space to reposition; others slam shut, forcing desperate sprints. Adaptability is your only constant ally.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Circle Mechanics: Beyond Random Chance[/b][/p][list][*][p]The first circle is born randomly at match start, ensuring each battle is unique.[/p][/*][*][p]Later zones build dynamically from the last, calculated with hidden factors that keep every match unpredictable.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/98821079cc8abd1644656bd4c2cbee4e1f505821.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Five Stages, Five Rewards: Quantum Barrels Await[/b]
Each of the five shrinking stages reveals a distinct type of quantum barrel, tied to the eternal cycle of Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal, and Water. These symbols of elemental power are scattered across the battlefield—collected not for immediate gain, but as currency and proof of mastery.[/p][p] [/p][p][u][b]2. Quantum Barrels – The Five Elements of Power[/b][/u][/p][p] [/p][p]Quantum barrels are no mere loot—they are the lifeblood of LEGEND BATTLES’ sci-fi economy.[/p][p] [/p][p]Each barrel aligns with an element:[/p][list][*][p]Red quantun barrel for Fire.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/fe1de74f4532e373c2832cb5d8c95c2765d9d545.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Yellow quantun barrel for Earth.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/1608c92d9f2a41ebd8b1f367a7e904f8f4aa2ef0.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Silver quantun barrel for Metal.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/f836b159450fcb9d30ed3a403bbf8cf968ec0899.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Blue quantun barrel for Water.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/219814d1921231ae3538c6f12458c5e40637edde.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Green quantun barrel for Wood.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/cbd52996c33474f08c7f7841aa2dba11ceb91e0c.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Collection Rules:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Only one element type appears per Playzone stage.[/p][/*][*][p]Across five stages, heroes can gather all five—if they survive.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p][b]Their Purpose:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Teleportation Currency[/b]: Pay a barrel to access teleport stations.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Endgame Jackpot[/b]: Deliver one of each element and win the session to unlock massive rewards in points and Battle Coins.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Prestige & Power[/b]: Barrels unlock legendary gear, rare skins, and vehicles—items tradeable at premium value on the Steam Community Market.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/b2b0e82a37c6a907981ddd74d72cf77066cba183.png"][/img][/p][p]In short: barrels are status, strategy, and survival all in one.[/p][p] [/p][p][b][u]3. Teleport Centers, Stations and Gates – Tear Open Spacev[/u][/b][/p][p] [/p][p]In the sprawling worlds of Bellona and Aurora, movement decides fate. The introduction of teleport centers, stations and gates changes everything, no longer must warriors trudge for minutes through hostile terrain. With barrels in hand, you bend space itself.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]What is a Teleport Hub?[/b]
A network of fast-travel platforms linking key regions. They allow near-instant relocation—but at a cost, and with risk.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/6d88f022cc7e18b8bf74e62d2496356dc7b44265.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Two Types of Teleport Hubs:[/b][/p][p]• Teleport Centers: Hidden in mountain hearts beyond ominous caverns and their cost is 2 quantum barrels. They can teleport on long distances to centers, stations and gates.[/p][p]• Teleport Stations: Found near cyberpunk villages and alien forests and their cost is 1 quantum barrel. They can teleport on short distances to centers, stations and gates.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/db64ccf3356b334207537b7426d726e03a7848ca.png"][/img][/p][p][b]What are Teleport Gates?[/b][/p][p]These are exit-only portals that provide an immediate, one-way exit from teleport centers and stations. Unlike the teleport centers and stations, they do not require quantum barrels and are often hidden in the surrounding environment, allowing for a quick escape or a surprise flank. They are a free but high-risk alternative to controlled travel.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/acf7e30171269c9385eaa6f5bce973494952a69f.png"][/img][/p][p][b]The Risk:[/b]
Hubs are natural killzones. Snipers and ambushers wait for careless travelers. To teleport is to gamble—victory or death.[/p][p][/p][p][b]The Rewards:[/b][/p][p][b]1. Speed[/b] – Less travel, more battle.[/p][p][b]2. Exploration[/b] – Venture into unknown zones with safety nets.[/p][p][b]3. Teamplay[/b] – Reunite with allies across vast maps.[/p][p][b]4. Accessibility[/b] – A guidepost for newcomers overwhelmed by sprawling landscapes.[/p][p] [/p][p]Teleport centers, stations and gates aren’t convenience; they are strategic weapons. Learn to wield them or risk being outmaneuvered.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/94e66b08e791bbb1ecc3b5d92febd7e86d56da4b.png"][/img][/p][p][u][b]4. Respawn Machines – Defy Death Itself[/b][/u][/p][p][/p][p]In LEGEND BATTLES, even death bends to technology. The Respawn System offers fallen warriors a second chance, if their allies have the courage to act.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]The Player Chip – Carrying Their Soul[/b]
When you fall, you leave behind a Player Chip. Teammates who recover it carry your essence—and your hope—toward resurrection.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/70212477f98bd77cfdf70a43a868aea5dbc9e1d7.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Respawn Stations – Monuments of Time[/b]
Towering sci-fi machines scattered across the battlefield, capable of bending reality itself.[/p][list][*][p][b]Activation[/b]: Deliver the chip to begin the process.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Time Travel[/b]: The machine pulls your teammate’s essence back from the past into the present.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tactical Value[/b]: Rare, contested, and always dangerous to approach.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Squad Salvation[/b]: A single activation can turn despair into triumph.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/07176802136b71a224653d8b2315c6adc8f8b9b2.png"][/img][/p][p][b]The Skyborn Return – By Hover Taxi[/b]
Respawns are not silent—they are spectacular.[/p][list][*][p][b]Yellow Hover Taxi[/b]: The legendary driverless cab descends from the clouds, carrying your ally from the timestream.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Parachute Drop[/b]: From the hover taxi, the revived player leaps back into the fight.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Landing Zones[/b]: Choose wisely—into cover, into your squad’s arms, or into loot-heavy danger.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fresh Start[/b]: Returned with minimal gear, survival depends on scavenging and teamwork.[/p][/*][/list][p][i]“The wind roared in my ears as I fell. No gun, no armor—only a heartbeat and a second chance.”[/i]
— Revived Combatant Testimony[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/7eac7bf4bf0b1661493a21b963bde070e254607e.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Limits of Resurrection[/b]
Respawns work only in the earlier phases. Once the final circles collapse, the stations shut down forever. Beyond that, death has no undoing.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Strategy Around Respawn[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Chip Runs[/b]: Decide whether to risk recovery under fire.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Station Control[/b]: Holding one can swing the match.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Safe Descent[/b]: Guide revived allies back into strength.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p][b]A Fight Beyond Death[/b]
Every chip carried, every station defended, every hover taxi ride, every parachute descent—it all tells a story of loyalty and defiance. In LEGEND BATTLES, even the laws of time bow to those who refuse to surrender.[/p][p][i]“Death is not the end here. It is the sky, the fall, and the fire that follows.”[/i]
— Inscription on a Respawn Terminal[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/0e2f2c833aff3b39bd9cf80078e68957a4b88102.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Conclusion – Will You Master the Future of Battle?[/b][/p][p]Quantum barrels, teleport hubs, respawn machines, hover taxis—each mechanic in [b]LEGEND BATTLES[/b] is a thread in a grand design. Together, they transform every match into a saga of survival, strategy, and spectacle.[/p][p][/p][p]Are you ready to adapt, outsmart the Playzone, harness the five elements, tear through space, and return from the brink of oblivion?[/p][p][/p][p]Fall. Be carried. Descend. Fight again. In LEGEND BATTLES, even the sky remembers your name.[/p][p][/p][p][u]Let’s recap what’s waiting for you in your legendary battles:[/u][/p][p] [/p][p]• Playzone[/p][p]A shrinking battlefield with unpredictable dynamics.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/be4d965499c5711fa99bdf19ad739008dd00eeae.gif"][/img][/p][p]
• Quantum Barrels[/p][p]Harness the quantum barrels of the five elemental powers during each stage of playzone shrinkage.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/257e410deeb22f626f39bda87470bc768212f319.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]• Teleport Center[/p][p]Long-distance travel from this center costs 2 quantum barrels.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/e63e96b55032ec6e5c4e965a5a610918fa9e1958.gif"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]• Teleport Station[/p][p]Short-distance jumps from this station cost 1 quantum barrel.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/ed7db9976fd59289f1bbd5658812758242b434f7.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]• Teleport Gate[/p][p]Exit portal from a teleport center or a teleport station.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/d5762a6f385e33c14046992d3d72579698b1ca90.gif"][/img][/p][p]
• Respawn[/p][p]Time-travel machines bring fallen teammates back to life from the past into the present.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/8da540bd0f0bcebdff55c1db3b859a0a12b234d1.gif"][/img][/p][p]
• Parachute Drop[/p][p]Respawned teammates re-enter the battlefield via a yellow air taxi.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/daa945eafcc5ce3a087cb51303ee04f88baf81d5.gif"][/img][/p][p]
• Protection[/p][p]Cover your returning teammates quickly. They drop in unarmed![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597765/7ed8edac05080f0ddbc86a3c710e5e90b9179e4e.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][u]Playtest Coming Soon[/u][/p][p]Dear Legends, Join us in the battle. Add LEGEND BATTLES to your Steam Wishlist and follow us to stay tuned for the official Playtest date and patch notes![/p][p] [/p][p]Enter the Command Room! Connect with fellow Legends, share your thoughts on the app, join exclusive Discord events, and get behind-the-scenes updates straight from the developers. Join us here [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/NJZFyFxjUm"]https://discord.gg/NJZFyFxjUm[/url][/p][p][/p][p]The LEGEND BATTLES Team[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3649730/Legend_Battles/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Player contact: [url="https://support@legendbattles.com"]support@legendbattles.com[/url][/p][p]Media contact: [url="https://media@legendbattles.com"]media@legendbattles.com[/url][/p][p]Partner contact: [url="https://partner@legendbattles.com"]partner@legendbattles.com[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Official website: [url="https://legendbattles.com/"]https://legendbattles.com/[/url][/p]
